components.label: Two-way cabinet
components.purpose: Moulded polypropylene two-way cabinet, 426 wide × 685 high × 383 deep mm and 17.3 kg. The EV drawing gives 685 mm height and 383 mm depth; the 426 mm width is from retailer copies of the EV table. Three handles and a pole cup underneath.
components.limits: EDS drawing gives height and depth; width is retailer-reproduced. Cabinet taper, handle shape and grille pattern are approximate.

components.label: EVS-15L 15-inch woofer
components.purpose: 15-inch EV-engineered EVS-15L low-frequency driver behind the steel grille, driven by the built-in 1000 W class-D amplifier.
components.limits: Driver model is retailer-reproduced from the EV table; position is behind an opaque grille.

components.label: DH-1K high-frequency driver and waveguide
components.purpose: DH-1K compression driver on EV's signal-synchronised waveguide, giving the published 90° × 60° coverage.

components.label: INPUT 1 · XLR/TRS combo
components.purpose: Balanced combo input for a mixer, instrument or microphone. The LCD menu sets LINE or MIC level for inputs 1 and 2 (EDS item 2).

components.label: INPUT 2 · XLR/TRS combo
components.purpose: Second balanced combo input, same LINE/MIC choice as input 1 (EDS item 3).

components.label: AUX IN · 3.5 mm
components.purpose: 3.5 mm stereo input for a phone or media player (EDS item 8). Bluetooth streaming is the wireless alternative where enabled.

components.label: OUTPUT · XLR mix out
components.purpose: Male XLR carrying the mix of every input to another speaker or a subwoofer (EDS item 7). The master volume and DSP settings do not change this signal; the Bluetooth stream can be included through the MIX OUT setting.

components.label: LCD and DSP controls
components.purpose: QuickSmartDSP menu on the rear LCD (EDS item 1): four presets, sub/top system match, two-band EQ, five user presets, limiter status, input meters and master level. The LCD lights about three seconds after power-on.

components.label: MAINS IN · IEC and POWER switch
components.purpose: IEC mains inlet (EDS item 5) with the POWER switch beside it (item 4).

components.label: Pole cup
components.purpose: Pole socket in the base for a 35 mm speaker stand or a sub-mounted pole.
components.limits: Pole cup position and depth are not in the readable part of the EDS.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated ZLX-15BT state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Sub and top together
The ZLX QuickSmartDSP has a sub/top system-match preset. With a sub below it, set the top to the matching preset so the crossover is shared rather than doubled, and feed the sub from the MIX OUT or split the signal before the top.
Preset names and the exact crossover point are in the EDS and manual; this model does not simulate DSP.
